note.p: Always disconnect the GrainFlow X50 from the power supply before performing any maintenance, cleaning, or repair work. Failure to do so may result in serious injury or death.
Keep hands, clothing, and tools clear of all moving parts while the GrainFlow X50 is in operation.
Always wear appropriate hearing protection when operating the GrainFlow X50. Noise levels can exceed 82 dB(A).
Only qualified electricians should perform electrical maintenance on the GrainFlow X50. Lock out/tag out procedures must be followed before opening any electrical panels.
